gates.name: Positive route and probe smoke
gates.reason: This gate needs a running container built from this repository's root Dockerfile. That build requires the nuget_github_token/nuget_github_actor BuildKit secrets (host-image.yml's 'Build the image' step) to restore SubZeroDev.Platform.Hosting from the cross-repo GitHub Packages feed inside the container — no local NuGet cache is available inside a fresh Docker build context the way it is for a host-side dotnet restore. Attempting `docker build -t subzerodev-gameengine-host:smoke .` without those secrets failed at the host-build restore stage: "cat: can't open '/run/secrets/nuget_github_actor': No such file or directory", "cat: can't open '/run/secrets/nuget_github_token': No such file or directory", then "error : Value cannot be null or empty string. (Parameter 'username')" from NuGet.targets, and the build step exited 1. This is a GitHub Actions secret (REGISTRY_TOKEN) not present in this environment; entering or fabricating one here is out of scope for a local verification pass. The corresponding CI check ('Platform Static Host Image / smoke') is where this answer will come from.
